help.faqIntro: Find clear answers about our research peptides, COAs, storage guidelines, ordering process, delivery information, and policies. This section is designed to ensure transparency, traceability, and strict research-use compliance.

faqs.a: Peptides are short chains of amino acids linked by peptide bonds. They occur naturally throughout the body and are also synthesised for laboratory work. In a research setting they are supplied as lyophilised (freeze-dried) reference materials for analytical, biochemical and educational study.

Research peptides are compounds manufactured and documented specifically for laboratory use. Each batch is produced to a defined specification and supplied with supporting documentation so that results can be reproduced and traced back to a known source.

faqs.q: Are these products for human use?
faqs.a: No. Every product sold by Zenvy Peptides is supplied strictly for laboratory research use only. They are not intended for human or veterinary use, consumption, injection, or any diagnostic, therapeutic or clinical application.

faqs.q: Do you provide dosing or guidance?
faqs.a: No. We do not provide dosing information, protocols, medical advice or usage instructions of any kind. All handling should follow your own laboratory safety procedures and applicable regulations.

A Certificate of Analysis (COA) documents the tested properties of a specific batch Ã¢â‚¬â€ most importantly purity and identity. "COA-verified" means the batch has been analysed and the results recorded against that batch number.

faqs.q: Why does purity matter in research?
faqs.a: Impurities can introduce variables that distort results and make comparisons between studies unreliable. Consistent, verified purity is what allows an experiment to be repeated and its outcome trusted.

faqs.q: How can I verify a product batch?
faqs.a: Each order is supplied with a batch-specific COA. You can also view the current published certificates on our Certificate of Analysis page, which lists the batch number, test date and purity for each product.
Yes. Every order is accompanied by a COA tied to the exact batch shipped, so the documentation always matches the material in your hands rather than a generic product-level certificate.

Zenvy Peptides is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring that all personal data is handled securely, transparently, and in accordance with applicable data protection laws. This Privacy Policy explains how your information is collected, used, and protected when you interact with our website and services.
1. Who We Are

Zenvy Peptides is a US-based supplier of research-use-only peptides. This Privacy Policy applies to all users and customers who access or purchase from our website. By using our services, you acknowledge and agree to the practices described in this policy.
2. Information We Collect

Zenvy Peptides may collect personal information such as your name, email address, billing and delivery details, and contact number when you place an order or contact support. We also process order-related information required to fulfil your purchase, along with secure payment processing handled by third-party providers. In addition, we may collect technical data such as IP address, browser type, device information, and website usage analytics to improve performance and security. Any information voluntarily submitted via contact forms or email may also be stored for support purposes. We do not store payment card details on our servers at any time.
3. How We Use Your Information

Zenvy Peptides uses collected data to process and fulfil orders, provide customer support, and ensure smooth website operation. Information may also be used to improve our services, enhance user experience, and maintain security standards. In certain cases, data may be used to detect or prevent fraudulent activity. Marketing communications are only sent if you have explicitly opted in. We do not sell or rent personal data to third parties.
4. Legal Basis for Processing

We process personal data under lawful bases including contractual necessity (order fulfilment), legal obligations (such as accounting and tax compliance), legitimate business interests (such as improving services and preventing fraud), and user consent where applicable, such as marketing preferences.
5. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

Zenvy Peptides uses cookies to enhance website functionality, improve user experience, and analyse traffic patterns. Cookies help maintain shopping cart functionality, remember user preferences, and monitor website performance. Users may manage or disable cookies through their browser settings, although this may affect certain features of the website.
6. Data Sharing

Personal data may be shared only with trusted third-party service providers involved in order processing, including payment gateways, courier services, analytics tools, and customer support systems. These providers are required to handle data securely and comply with applicable data protection regulations. Your information is only shared when necessary to deliver services or complete transactions.
7. Data Security

Zenvy Peptides implements appropriate security measures to protect your data, including encrypted connections, secure hosting environments, and restricted access controls. Payment information is handled exclusively by secure third-party processors. While we take strong precautions, no online system can guarantee absolute security.
8. Your Rights

Depending on your state of residence, you may have the right to access, update, delete, or restrict the use of your personal data, as well as the right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information where applicable (for example, under state privacy laws such as the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA)). You may also withdraw consent for marketing communications at any time. To exercise any of these rights, you can contact support at support@zenvypeptides.com.
9. Data Retention

Personal data is retained only for as long as necessary to fulfil its intended purpose. Order and transaction records may be retained for legal and accounting requirements, typically up to six years. Marketing data is retained until you opt out, and analytics data is stored in accordance with provider policies.
10. International Data Transfers

Some data may be processed by service providers located outside the United States. In such cases, appropriate safeguards are implemented to ensure data protection standards remain consistent and secure.
11. Third-Party Links
Our website may include links to external websites. Zenvy Peptides is not responsible for the privacy practices or content of third-party sites.
12. Policy Updates
Zenvy Peptides may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect operational, legal, or regulatory changes. Any updates will be published on this page with immediate effect.
